narrative_summary: The S&P 500 closed essentially flat at 7,413 after a third straight session of basing just beneath the 20/50-day SMA cluster and below the entire 23.6–61.8% retracement band of the 7/08–7/15 leg. The long-term skeleton remains bullish — the 50-day sits above a rising 200-day and extension is only +5.8% — but every confirming layer is absent: McClellan breadth is at cycle lows, net new highs are fading, ERP is pinned at 0.47% in the valuation-ceiling band, and VIX has held above its 50-day MA without producing a capitulation spike. Monte Carlo remains decisively down-first at 64.1% with a 5-day median to 7,354 versus 15 days to the 7,581 swing high, failing all regime thresholds. This is a late-cycle stall, not a re-entry setup: hold trims, deploy nothing, and wait for either a reclaim of the 50-day with breadth confirmation or a flush toward 7,354/7,202 with a VIX spike and reversal.

confirming_evidence: Long-term trend structure intact: 50-day SMA (7,472) remains above a clearly rising 200-day SMA (7,006), with the 3-year chart showing an unbroken series of higher highs and higher lows.
Extension is modest at +5.82% above the 200-day — only 'moderate extension', not the extreme readings that precede violent mean reversion; Rally Exhaustion Score is Low.

Price is holding a three-day base above the 7/08 swing low (7,421.82) and well above the re-anchored liquidation-caution level (7,354); the 1-month chart shows the decline decelerating into a sideways coil rather than accelerating.
MFI on the 5-day and 1-month charts has turned up from the high-30s to ~55-60 while price flatlined — a modest bullish money-flow divergence suggesting selling pressure is abating.
Credit is neutral-to-supportive: junk-vs-IG spread at 1.30 sits right at its 1-year average and has been easing from the 1.38 July spike, so credit is not confirming a risk-off break.
Forward PE of 19.56x sits in the 18-20x 'moderate buying at support' band, keeping the valuation floor from being outright restrictive on a multiple basis.

Intraday chart shows a constructive session shape: after a sharp 9:30-10:45 flush to 7,388, price built a rising sequence of higher lows into a 3:20 PM push to 7,422, closing in the upper third of the daily range.
VIX at 18.67 remains inside the 15-20 standard operating band — no crisis regime, no breakdown in the reliability of moving-average support.
